entries.test: Public incident reports and contemporaneous ChatGPT outputs would establish whether it suffered a conspicuous malfunction and whether an explanation was available when the post appeared.
entries.note: The malfunction is asserted as a premise of the surrounding rhetorical question.

entries.test: Contemporaneous public Gemini outputs would establish whether it failed to correctly identify the Apollo 11 crew.
entries.note: “Remember” has a plain reading here as supplying correct information, rather than possessing human memory.

entries.test: Published technical documentation and formal verification results available at publication would establish whether these systems had formal guarantees of reliable performance.
entries.note: This asserts the present absence of formal guarantees; it does not predict that the systems will never work.

entries.test: Marcus's dated public writings and statements would establish whether he described LLMs as oversold from the outset of his commentary on them.
entries.note: The test concerns his history of saying this, rather than whether LLMs deserve the judgment “oversold.”
